questions.stem: Which of the following is a finite (non-renewable) resource?
questions.explanation: Crude oil is a finite resource because it was formed over millions of years from ancient organisms and is being used much faster than it can be replaced. Solar energy, wind energy, and biomass from crops are all renewable because they are continuously replenished or can be regrown.

options.text: When two factories compete for the same resources
When the waste from one industrial process is used as a raw material for another
When factories share the same buildings
When industries move to the same country

questions.explanation: Industrial symbiosis is when the waste or by-products from one industrial process become the raw materials for another. For example, waste heat from a power station could heat greenhouses, or a by-product from one chemical plant could be a feedstock for another. This reduces overall waste and energy use.
